name: coronium-mobile-proxies
description: Check the health of the dedicated 4G/5G mobile proxies you rent from Coronium.io, rotate their IP, get connection details, compare plans and renewal quotes, and open support tickets, from Claude Code. The plugin runs the server's directory profile, which has no money tools, so it does not spend. Spending is off by default in the server too; its separate buyer profile with CORONIUM_ENABLE_SPENDING=1 can buy from your balance after you confirm the exact total.

api_token.title: Coronium API token
api_token.description: The dashboard API token from dashboard.coronium.io, Account -> API Access. Claude Code keeps it in your system's secure credential store.
